  <style>
    /* ==========================================================================
       CSS VARIABLES & THEME DEFINITIONS
       ========================================================================== */
    :root {
      /* Color Palette - Dark Default */
      --bg-primary: #0b0f17;
      --bg-secondary: #111827;
      --bg-tertiary: #1f2937;
      --bg-card: rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.75);

      --accent-primary: #6366f1;
      --accent-secondary: #ec4899;
      --accent-tertiary: #10b981;
      --accent-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1 0%, #a855f7 50%, #ec4899 100%);

      --radius-sm: 8px;

      --radius-lg: 24px;
      --radius-full: 9999px;
      
      --transition-fast: 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      --transition-normal: 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      --transition-slow: 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      
      --font-main: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
      --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
    }

    [data-theme="light"] {
      --bg-primary: #f8fafc;
      --bg-secondary: #ffffff;
      --bg-tertiary: #f1f5f9;
      --bg-card: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
      --bg-card-hover: rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.95);
      --bg-glass: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
      
      --text-primary: #0f172a;
      --text-secondary: #475569;
      --text-muted: #94a3b8;
      
      --accent-primary: #4f46e5;
      --accent-secondary: #db2777;
      --accent-tertiary: #059669;
      --accent-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #4f46e5 0%, #9333ea 50%, #db2777 100%);
      --accent-glow: rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.2);
      
      --border-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
      --border-color-hover: rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.4);
      
      --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.05);
      --shadow-md: 0 8px 24px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);
      --shadow-lg: 0 16px 40px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12);
      --shadow-glow: 0 0 30px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.15);
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
       BASE RESET & GLOBAL STYLES
       ========================================================================== */
    *,
    *::before,
    *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font-main);
      background-color: var(--bg-primary);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      line-height: 1.6;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      transition: background-color var(--transition-normal), color var(--transition-normal);
    }

    ::selection {
      background: var(--accent-primary);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    /* Ambient Background Glows */
    .ambient-bg {
      position: fixed;

      left: 0;
      width: 100vw;
      height: 100vh;
      pointer-events: none;

    .section {

    /* Section Header */
    .section-header {

    }
    .section-subtitle {
      display: inline-block;

      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;

    .section-title {

      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .section-description {
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    .gradient-text {
      background: var(--accent-gradient);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
       NAVBAR
       ========================================================================== */
    .navbar {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      z-index: 1000;
      padding: 1.25rem 0;
      transition: all var(--transition-normal);
    }
    .navbar.scrolled {
      padding: 0.85rem 0;

    }
    .nav-menu {

      gap: 2rem;
      list-style: none;

    }
    .theme-toggle:hover {

    .theme-toggle svg {

      height: 20px;

      stroke: currentColor;
      stroke-width: 2;
      stroke-linecap: round;
      stroke-linejoin: round;
    }
    .icon-sun { display: none; }
    .icon-moon { display: block; }
    [data-theme="light"] .icon-sun { display: block; }
    [data-theme="light"] .icon-moon { display: none; }

    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 0.5rem;
    }
    .hamburger span {
      width: 24px;
      height: 2px;
      background-color: var(--text-primary);
      transition: all var(--transition-normal);
      border-radius: 2px;

    /* Mobile Nav Drawer */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {

        transition: right var(--transition-normal);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      }
      .nav-menu.open { right: 0; }
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
       BUTTONS & BADGES
       ========================================================================== */
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.6rem;
      padding: 0.85rem 1.75rem;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
    }
    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--accent-gradient);
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px var(--accent-glow);
    }
    .btn-primary:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 25px var(--accent-glow);
    }
    .btn-secondary {
      background: var(--bg-tertiary);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    }
    .btn-secondary:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent-primary);

    .btn-sm {
      padding: 0.5rem 1rem;

    .status-badge {
      display: inline-flex;

      gap: 0.5rem;

      border-radius: var(--radius-full);

    .status-pulse {

      border-radius: 50%;
      position: relative;
    }
    .status-pulse::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: -4px;

      border: 2px solid var(--accent-tertiary);
      animation: pulse 2s infinite;

    @keyframes pulse {
      0% { transform: scale(0.8); opacity: 1; }
      100% { transform: scale(2); opacity: 0; }
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
       HERO SECTION
       ========================================================================== */
    .hero {
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 7rem;

    .hero-grid {

      align-items: center;

    }
    .hero-typewriter {

      animation: blink 0.75s step-end infinite;
    }
    @keyframes blink {
      from, to { border-color: transparent }
      50% { border-color: var(--accent-primary); }
    }
    .hero-description {
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
      max-width: 580px;
    }
    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 3rem;
    }
    
    /* Quick Stats */
    .hero-stats {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 1.5rem;
      padding-top: 2rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    }
    .stat-item h4 {
      font-size: 2rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
    }
    .stat-item p {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    /* Avatar Card Visual */
    .hero-visual {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    .avatar-card {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;

    .projects-controls {

    }

    /* Modal Styles */
    .modal-backdrop {

      margin: 0 auto;

      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 20px;
      width: 2px;
      background: var(--border-color);
    }
    @media (min-width: 768px) {

        left: 50%;
        transform: translateX(-50%);

      top: 0;

      projectsGrid.innerHTML = '';
      const filtered = projectsData.filter(proj => {
        const matchesCat = activeCategory === 'all' || proj.category === activeCategory;
        const searchTarget = `${proj.title} ${proj.description} ${proj.tech.join(' ')}`.toLowerCase();
        const matchesSearch = searchTarget.includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
        return matchesCat && matchesSearch;
      });

      if (filtered.length === 0) {
        projectsGrid.innerHTML = `<div style="grid-column: 1/-1; text-align: center; padding: 3rem; color: var(--text-muted);">No projects found matching your search query.</div>`;
        return;
      }

      filtered.forEach(proj => {
        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'project-card';
        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="project-banner">
            ${proj.emoji}
            <div class="project-banner-overlay"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="project-content">
            <div class="project-category">${proj.categoryLabel}</div>
            <h3 class="project-title">${proj.title}</h3>
            <p class="project-desc">${proj.description}</p>
            <div class="project-tags">
              ${proj.tech.map(t => `<span class="pill">${t}</span>`).join('')}
            </div>
            <div class="project-actions">
              <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick="openModal('${proj.id}')">View Details</button>
              <a href="${proj.githubUrl}" target="_blank" class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm">GitHub</a>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
        projectsGrid.appendChild(card);
      });
    }

    filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        filterBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        activeCategory = btn.getAttribute('data-filter');
        renderProjects();
      });
    });

    projectSearchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
      searchQuery = e.target.value;
      renderProjects();
    });

    renderProjects();

    // Project Modal Popup Logic
    const modal = document.getElementById('project-modal');
    const modalBody = document.getElementById('modal-body');
    const modalCloseBtn = document.getElementById('modal-close-btn');

    window.openModal = function(id) {
      const proj = projectsData.find(p => p.id === id);
      if (!proj) return;
      modalBody.innerHTML = `
        <div style="font-size: 3rem; margin-bottom: 1rem;">${proj.emoji}</div>
        <div class="project-category">${proj.categoryLabel}</div>
        <h2 style="font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 1rem;">${proj.title}</h2>
        <p style="color: var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.6;">${proj.longDescription}</p>
        <div style="margin-bottom: 1.5rem;">
          <h4 style="font-size: 0.9rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; color: var(--text-muted);">TECH STACK USED:</h4>
          <div class="project-tags">
            ${proj.tech.map(t => `<span class="pill">${t}</span>`).join('')}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style="display: flex; gap: 1rem;">
          <a href="#" onclick="showToast('Demo link opened'); return false;" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm">Live Preview</a>
          <a href="#" onclick="showToast('Repository link clicked'); return false;" class="btn btn-secondary btn-sm">Source Code</a>
        </div>
      `;
      modal.classList.add('open');
    };

    modalCloseBtn.addEventListener('click', () => modal.classList.remove('open'));
    modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target === modal) modal.classList.remove('open');
    });

    // 4. Skills Section Data & Interactive Progress Bars
    const skillsData = [
      { name: 'TypeScript / JavaScript', category: 'frontend', level: 95, icon: '⚡' },
      { name: 'React & Next.js', category: 'frontend', level: 92, icon: '⚛️' },
      { name: 'HTML5 / CSS3 / Tailwind', category: 'frontend', level: 98, icon: '🎨' },
      { name: 'Python & FastAPI', category: 'backend', level: 90, icon: '🐍' },
      { name: 'Node.js & Express', category: 'backend', level: 88, icon: '🟢' },
      { name: 'PostgreSQL & Redis', category: 'backend', level: 85, icon: '🗄️' },
      { name: 'PyTorch & AI Fine-Tuning', category: 'ai', level: 82, icon: '🤖' },
      { name: 'LangChain & RAG Pipelines', category: 'ai', level: 86, icon: '🔗' },
      { name: 'AWS & Kubernetes', category: 'backend', level: 80, icon: '☁️' }
    ];

    const skillsGrid = document.getElementById('skills-grid');
    const skillCatBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.skills-filter .filter-btn');

    function renderSkills(cat = 'all') {
      skillsGrid.innerHTML = '';
      const filtered = skillsData.filter(s => cat === 'all' || s.category === cat);
      
      filtered.forEach(skill => {
        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'skill-card';
        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="skill-header">
            <div class="skill-info">
              <div class="skill-icon">${skill.icon}</div>
              <div class="skill-title">${skill.name}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="skill-percentage">${skill.level}%</div>
          </div>
          <div class="skill-progress">
            <div class="skill-bar" data-level="${skill.level}"></div>
          </div>
        `;
        skillsGrid.appendChild(card);
      });

      // Trigger progress bar filling animation
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.skill-bar').forEach(bar => {
          const level = bar.getAttribute('data-level');
          bar.style.width = `${level}%`;
        });
      }, 50);
    }

    skillCatBtns.forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        skillCatBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        renderSkills(btn.getAttribute('data-skill-cat'));
      });
    });

    renderSkills();

    // 5. Experience Timeline Data & Interactive Expanders
    const experienceData = [
      {
        role: 'Principal AI & Full-Stack Architect',
        company: 'Vanguard Systems Inc.',
        date: '2022 - PRESENT',
        summary: 'Leading cross-functional engineering teams in delivering autonomous AI systems and high-frequency real-time analytics platforms.',
        details: 'Architected scalable microservice ecosystems handling 5M+ daily requests. Led the migration of legacy monolith to containerized Kubernetes deployment, cutting cloud costs by 32%.'
      },
      {
        role: 'Senior Full-Stack Engineer',
        company: 'Apex Digital Labs',
        date: '2019 - 2022',
        summary: 'Spearheaded frontend architecture modernization using Next.js, React, and GraphQL APIs.',
        details: 'Built scalable real-time dashboard applications utilized by enterprise clients. Mentored 8 junior and mid-level developers in modern TypeScript and CSS architecture.'
      },
      {
        role: 'Software Engineer',
        company: 'Nexus Software Technologies',
        date: '2017 - 2019',
        summary: 'Developed RESTful services in Node.js, Python backend pipelines, and dynamic UI components.',
        details: 'Optimized PostgreSQL queries reducing DB CPU load by 40%. Implemented Redis caching layers and end-to-end automated testing suites.'
      }
    ];

    const timelineContainer = document.getElementById('timeline-container');

    function renderTimeline() {
      timelineContainer.innerHTML = '';
      experienceData.forEach((exp, idx) => {
        const item = document.createElement('div');
        item.className = 'timeline-item';
        item.innerHTML = `
          <div class="timeline-badge"></div>
          <div class="timeline-content">
            <div class="timeline-date">${exp.date}</div>
            <div class="timeline-role">${exp.role}</div>
            <div class="timeline-company">🏢 ${exp.company}</div>
            <p class="timeline-details">${exp.summary}</p>
            <button class="timeline-toggle-btn" onclick="toggleTimelineDetails(this)">Read More +</button>
            <div class="timeline-more">
              <p class="timeline-details">${exp.details}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
        timelineContainer.appendChild(item);
      });
    }

    window.toggleTimelineDetails = function(btn) {
      const moreDiv = btn.nextElementSibling;
      if (moreDiv.classList.contains('show')) {
        moreDiv.classList.remove('show');
        btn.textContent = 'Read More +';
      } else {
        moreDiv.classList.add('show');
        btn.textContent = 'Show Less -';
      }
    };

    renderTimeline();

    // 6. Contact Form Validation & Toast Notifications
    const contactForm = document.getElementById('contact-form');
    const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
    const toastMsg = document.getElementById('toast-message');
    let toastTimeout;

    window.showToast = function(msg) {
      toastMsg.textContent = msg;
      toast.classList.add('show');
      clearTimeout(toastTimeout);
      toastTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.remove('show');
      }, 3000);
    };

    window.copyText = function(text, label) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
        showToast(label || 'Copied to clipboard!');
      }).catch(() => {
        showToast('Copied to clipboard!');
      });
    };

    contactForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const name = document.getElementById('user_name').value;
      showToast(`Thank you, ${name}! Your message has been sent.`);
      contactForm.reset();
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>
